reason: After the 640 and 960 detector-validation reports were complete, the detector objective was clarified to include localization-suitable bottom-centre accuracy and verified five-camera runtime feasibility. The original rule would prefer 640 after a recall tie. This amendment selects 960 because its matched-box bottom-centre error is lower and the exact checkpoint meets the 5 Hz runtime budget.

timing.reporting_requirement: Describe this as a post-validation, pre-commissioning amendment. Do not describe the localization criterion as preregistered.

ineligible_candidate.reason: Intentional termination after one head-warmup epoch; no completed candidate checkpoint or eligible validation report.

localization_diagnostic.population: The 637 detector-validation positive images matched at confidence >= 0.25 and IoU >= 0.5 for both completed candidates.
localization_diagnostic.point: Euclidean distance in source-image pixels between the ground-truth mask-box bottom centre and the highest-confidence matched prediction bottom centre.
localization_diagnostic.percentile_method: Linear interpolation on sorted observations at index (n-1)p.

constraints: The diagnostic changes only selection between already-completed 640 and 960 trials.
The selected detector is not claimed to provide valid localization without the Stage-06 admission gate.
No accepted validation positive is in the 16-31 pixel visible-width bin; no few-pixel capability claim is permitted.
The final audit remains sealed until all downstream models and thresholds are frozen.
